profile.headline: Engineering Manager at LinkedIn | Building Agentic LI Hiring Assistant
profile.summary:
I love building and learning something new everyday! It doesn't matter if it's from self taught, others' great work, traditional academia or bite size courses. Besides driving growth through data driven decision, I'm interested in computational neuroscience and deep learning for time series.

Fun facts: I won 2nd place in 2007 JP Morgan trading competition.

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Leading Hiring Platform Core team of 9 amazing engineers to build the foundation and core components of everything hiring and recruiting.

Led Glint Setup and Launch - Surveys and Conversations team. Volunteered as NSBE judge and LTS WIT Cultivate co-lead.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer/TLM
positions.description: TLM of Surveys & Conversations team. Completed Apprentice Manager Program and Women In Tech Invest.

positions.title: Software Engineer Technical Lead
positions.description:
●​ Led a team of 14 engineers across backend, API, and UI to deliver impactful product features and systems.
●​ Delivered site performance gains of 50% through technical refactors in Angular, TypeScript, and Node.js.
●​ Architected org-wide E2E test automation framework, reducing QA time and improving reliability.
●​ Elevated engineering bar by mentoring, leading onboarding bootcamps, and improving hiring process design.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Led design and development of several projects in IAM, ODS and E2E Infra. Taught several UI bootcamps and completed AI200 training.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Previously Bunker Capital.

Led a team of full-stack engineers to deliver multiple applications for TessaB ecosystem.

●​ Aligned product, UX, and engineering teams for delivery of high-velocity, responsive applications.
